name: get_materials_and_sections
author: hprebar
title: Get materials and frame sections
description: Lists the material properties (type, E in MPa, Poisson ratio, thermal coefficient, G in MPa) and the frame section properties (shape type, area in m², I22/I33 in m⁴, S/Z in m³, radii of gyration in m) defined in the model. Read-only.
notes: OAPI: cPropMaterial.GetNameList/GetMaterial/GetMPIsotropic, cPropFrame.GetNameList/GetTypeOAPI/GetSectProps. Stresses come back in kN/m² under the forced units and are reported /1000 as MPa.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–500)
